narrative.data_gaps_md:
This section provides a transparent assessment of evidence coverage quality and identifies capabilities where additional internal evidence would materially change the assessment findings. Transparency about evidence gaps builds assessment credibility and frames discovery conversations.
P1 Strategy, Governance & Culture -- Coverage: 72% (134/186 subcaps) -- Overall Confidence: MEDIUM
Evidence Gaps:
 Innovation Culture (38% T1 evidence; no public innovation governance framework disclosed -- 3 trademarked methodologies are execution, not governance)
 Digital Strategy documentation (formal strategy document, board KPI framework, technology roadmap all absent from public sources)
 Talent -- no public HRIS, DEI metrics, or talent pipeline disclosure beyond leadership bios
Recommended Discovery:
Discovery session with Sarah Musante (CHRO) to understand talent management maturity; review of any internal digital strategy documents or board presentations via Zennify pre-sales engagement
Confidence Note: Governance is HIGH confidence (Form ADV Items 11-18, Tom Woods Hightower pedigree, IAPD clean record -- T1 evidence). Innovation is LOW confidence (execution signals only, no governance framework signals).
P2 Client & Advisor Experience -- Coverage: 45% (107/233 subcaps) -- LOWEST PILLAR -- Overall Confidence: LOW-MEDIUM
Evidence Gaps:
Client satisfaction and NPS scores not publicly available for a 16-month-old private RIA
Advisor satisfaction, Glassdoor data, internal engagement metrics not accessible
Client portal usage rates, mobile app engagement metrics (VestGen Mobile iOS 6450509679) not disclosed
Marketing automation production status (HubSpot build stage unknown -- Sean McGee pedigree only)
Wealth planning utilization rates (eMoney + MoneyGuidePro dual system -- which is primary, adoption rates unknown)
Recommended Discovery:
Discovery session with Ferian Nickelson (COO) and Devon Gutierrez (SF CRM liaison) to understand FSC usage rates, Orion client portal engagement, and advisor productivity metrics; Hubbl scan to surface FSC org utilization depth
Confidence Note: Client Analytics is MEDIUM-HIGH confidence (Power BI + Snowflake confirmed). Advisor Experience is LOW confidence on internal advisor productivity metrics (Zocks usage confirmed but depth unknown). Marketing is LOW confidence (HubSpot status inferred from Sean McGee pedigree only, not confirmed production).
P3 Operations & Compliance -- Coverage: 70% (83/118 subcaps) -- Overall Confidence: MEDIUM-HIGH
Evidence Gaps:
 AML program -- NOT disclosed publicly (confirmed greenfield); internal program status unknown
 STP rates and automation metrics -- quarterly billing automation confirmed but broader STP unknown
 Fraud detection specifics -- custodian-delegated; VestGen-side fraud controls unknown
 Vendor risk scoring methodology and BCP testing cadence -- not publicly disclosed
Recommended Discovery:
Discovery session with Timothy Woods (CLO/CCO) on AML program build status, compliance testing calendar, and vendor risk framework; Ferian Nickelson (COO) on STP rates and exception handling workflows
Confidence Note: overall is HIGH confidence (Tom Woods pedigree + Form ADV framework + IAPD clean record). AML is HIGH confidence of being a gap (absence is confirmed, not inferred). RPA is HIGH confidence of gap (zero signal across all research).
P4 Data, Analytics & Technology -- Coverage: 98% (169/172 subcaps) -- HIGHEST PILLAR -- Overall Confidence: HIGH (public surface rich due to job postings)
Evidence Gaps:
Security controls specifics -- no SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, pen test results publicly available; Form ADV cyber disclosure [E-082] confirms risk but not controls
Data catalog tool (Alation/Collibra/Atlan/Purview) -- no signal; Snowflake + Power BI native lineage assumed
DevOps pipeline specifics -- Salesforce 'Change Management' listed as manual skill; actual CI/CD maturity unknown beyond level 1-level 2 inference
HubSpot production status -- Sean McGee pedigree implies in-build; not independently confirmed as production
Recommended Discovery:
Hubbl Diagnostics free org scan as immediate next step -- surfaces FSC org technical debt, integration patterns, data quality; Roberto Moreno-Arellano (Tech Integrations) technical discovery on Azure+Snowflake architecture depth; Timothy Woods for CCPA readiness assessment
Confidence Note: Data Architecture is HIGH confidence (job postings document Snowflake medallion + FSC data model explicitly). Security is MEDIUM confidence (absence of signals is confirmed across 5 security databases and zero job postings -- vendor-inherited posture is the only reasonable inference).
